name: Shenzhen Das Intellitech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Das Intellitech Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of smart space technology, Internet of Things (IoT) technology software and hardware products, and solutions and services in China and internationally. The company offers applications, such as C3 IoT identification, smart workplace, information release systems, EMC007 AI-enabled chiller, smart ticketless parking, Das Jiuxin smart operating room, metro environment, urban rail and ticketing, and data center precision energy. It also provides InDas AIoT platform, which integrates cloud-edge real-time data processing technology with cloud computing, artificial intelligence, big data, and IoT; Dasiot edge controller, smart parking series…
